# Offer Design Skill for Muse

Turns Muse into an offer-design expert focused on improving the offer itself, not the copy that sells it. Built around the value equation — Dream Outcome × Perceived Likelihood of Achievement over Time Delay × Effort & Sacrifice — it diagnoses which lever is broken, audits the six components of a complete offer (core deliverable, bonus stack, guarantee, scarcity/urgency, name, price + payment structure), and ships one-lever iterations with honest lift projections: most single-component changes deliver 10–40% conversion lift, not 5x. It includes format playbooks for services, courses, coaching, info products, SaaS lead magnets, agency retainers, and high-ticket B2B, anonymized before/after worked examples, and clear guardrails — no fake scarcity, no over-promising guarantees, no bonus inflation, no course-bro aesthetic on serious products, and no discounting to acquire (discount-askers churn at ~2x the rate of full-price customers). If you run self-serve SaaS it tells you honestly to read pricing first, since tier structure does more work there. Discovered via skills.sh. Skills.sh Trust Hub: Pass. Honest note: it's deliberately opinionated — its banned-vocabulary list rejects empty superlatives ("revolutionary," "game-changing," "secret method") and fake urgency patterns in favor of specific numbers, named customers, and real timelines; the deep reference library (value equation, offer anatomy, guarantee design, bonus stacking, real scarcity, worked examples, SaaS offers)...
